items.title: Frank Netto Interview, 1986-11-10
items.q: Red came in there. And Bill got off a night or two and he played for Bill. But Red never played any length of time. Maybe he might have made as much as a week with us or something like that.

ctx.x: That didn't work there, but I mean when Hip had the Two Bits Club... He used to come out there with the money that he collected from Prima and Chalky, which was used to get about $200 and he'd come up just to have about enough to pay the band off out there at the Hunnysuckle Inn.

We were working at the Hunnysuckle Inn. We were across the street because we stayed a couple of years at the 25 Cent Club, and then we went over to the Hunnysuckle Inn. That's when Eddie Miller left with Tony Almerico. And he said, I told him, I said, Eddie, I said, you can play as good as the rest of them guys up there. I said, you might have to sweat it out. Go ahead and sweat it out and go ahead up there. So he went over there and he... Remember he went up to Rose... What was the hell he called? Rose Garden or…
